amber-without-vendor.json.rule: an amber record names its vendor (ADR-0051 (c))

article-key-not-the-canonical-urls.json.rule: an article is keyed by its canonical URL (plan L165; ADR-0036)

article-unknown-field.json.rule: the article extract carries only its typed fields (F-30)

article-without-extractor.json.rule: an article payload is the typed extract (F-30)

bot-without-update-id.json.rule: a bot record carries its delivery id in context (ADR-0005)

comment-without-author-ref.json.rule: a comment carries author_ref, null where the platform gives none (Q3)

context-partial-one.json.rule: a constant keeps its JSON type: 0 is not false and true is not 1 (finding 6)

key-not-the-helpers.json.rule: the key equals the helper's output for the record (ADR-0006)

metrics-without-item-key.json.rule: a metrics record names the observed item's key (ADR-0034; F-37)

neither-source-nor-candidate.json.rule: a record carries source_id or candidate_key (ADR-0005)

non-utc-fetched-at.json.rule: message timestamps are UTC with Z

numeric-platform-id.json.rule: platform ids are strings, never numbers (ADR-0007)

payload-key-lone-surrogate.json.rule: every string and key is well-formed Unicode (UTF-8 encodable, ADR-0006)

payload-lone-surrogate.json.rule: every string and key is well-formed Unicode (UTF-8 encodable, ADR-0006)

payload-nested-too-deep.json.rule: a free-form value nests 64 levels at most, counted from that value (D-5)

payload-number-1e400.json.rule: a number is finite: 1e400 is no number either language holds (D-5)

prefixed-author-ref.json.rule: author_ref is 64 lower-case hex, no prefix (ADR-0010)

raw-ref-route-mismatch.json.rule: raw_ref names the record's own route and platform (ADR-0005)

reaction-without-platform-id.json.rule: a reaction is keyed by its event id (F-37)

reason-as-job-kind.json.rule: job_kind is a job kind, push or stream (ADR-0005, ADR-0011)

resolver-writes-post.json.rule: a raw.items writer writes only its record kinds

result-key-not-the-helpers.json.rule: a web result's key is web:result:<canonical_url_hash> (ADR-0038)

search-response-candidate-key.json.rule: a search response is keyed by its rule's source_id (plan L165; D-10)

search-response-commoncrawl-source-id.js.rule: web-commoncrawl-scanner's aggregate is keyed by its candidate (plan L165; D-10)

search-response-neither.json.rule: a search response is keyed by the rule's source_id (ADR-0005)

source-and-candidate.json.rule: a record carries source_id or candidate_key, never both (ADR-0005 L28)

stream-without-connection-id.json.rule: a stream record carries its delivery id in context (ADR-0005)

undeclared-context-key.json.rule: context holds only its producer's declared keys (ADR-0005)

unknown-kind.json.rule: the record kind is one of ADR-0008's

unknown-service.json.rule: producer.service is a service of the index (Q1, F-09)

vendor-spelling.json.rule: one lower-case vendor spelling, from the registry (ADR-0051 (c))
